disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price, with a divergence z-score of 3.792 [P2]. The signal spans seven sources, led by lobbying (z=1.236), congressional net buying (z=0.859), and federal contracts (z=0.668), but grants are only mildly positive while material 8-K events and pre-award solicitations are negative [P3]. Durability is plausible but unproven: fused acceleration is positive and news velocity is accelerating [P3][P5], yet the pack provides no multi-period history establishing persistence. Price has not confirmed—the group’s 60-day relative strength is deeply negative—so the emerging positive divergence remains early rather than validated [P1][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实际活动明显领先于价格，二者背离读数为3.792 [P2]。七类来源中，游说升温、国会议员净买入和联邦合同最强，但拨款机会仅略有改善，重大公司事件与招标前通知仍为负 [P3]。综合活动正在加速，新闻速度也有所上升 [P3][P5]，但材料没有提供足够的跨期记录来证明这种势头能够持续。过去60天该主题显著跑输大盘，因此价格尚未确认这一早期背离 [P1][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, lobbying and congressional buying are picking up, but early procurement notices and material company announcements remain soft. News activity is accelerating, although there is not yet enough history to show that the improvement will persist. Prices have fallen well behind the market, so it is worth watching for broader follow-through before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、游说活动和国会议员买入正在升温，但采购前期通知和公司的重大事项仍然偏弱。相关新闻有所加速，不过现有记录还不足以证明改善能够持续。相关资产明显跑输大盘，现阶段宜继续观察，等待更多实际活动跟进后再投入资金。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that activity already leads price by an unusually large margin [P2], while positive acceleration and improving news flow could mark the start of a durable re-rating before prices respond [P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if the next readings keep fused acceleration positive and turn pre-award solicitations and material 8-K events positive, while relative strength stabilizes or improves [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if lobbying, congressional buying, or federal-contract signals roll over, fused acceleration turns negative, or relative performance continues deteriorating without improvement in solicitations and material events [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is materially ahead of price, with divergence at 1.814 and fused acceleration at 2.301 [P2][P3]. Strength spans seven sources, led by a very strong regulatory pipeline (3.468) and pre-award solicitations (1.085), alongside positive news, congressional buying, and lobbying signals [P3]. Durability is supported by accelerating news flow and entirely unscheduled news, but remains uncertain because material 8-K events are negative and grant opportunities are flat [P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed: 60-day relative strength versus the market is -8.78%, making this an activity-led entry rather than a momentum-confirmed one [P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动明显领先价格，背离读数为1.814，综合加速度为2.301 [P2][P3]。七类来源中，监管项目管线和招标前需求最强，新闻、国会净买入及游说活动也为正 [P3]。持续性获得新闻加速和非计划新闻的支持，但重大8-K事件为负、联邦资助机会持平，仍构成不确定性 [P3][P5]。过去60天相对大盘落后8.78%，因此价格尚未确认，这是由活动领先驱动的布局机会 [P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Regulatory work and early-stage federal purchasing activity around semiconductor equipment are picking up, while news, lobbying and congressional buying also lean positive. Equipment shares have lagged the market by about 9% over the past 60 days, so prices have not yet reflected that improvement. A cautious initial position is reasonable, but stronger corporate announcements or actual awards are needed to show the pickup will last.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 半导体设备相关的监管工作和联邦采购前期活动正在升温，新闻、游说活动和国会买入也偏向积极。相关公司股价过去60天落后大盘约9%，价格尚未反映这些改善。可以谨慎建立初始仓位，但仍需看到更多企业重大公告或实际订单，才能确认这轮回升能够持续。
assessments.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that the apparent acceleration is disproportionately driven by the regulatory pipeline, while federal grant opportunities are flat and material 8-K events are negative; without conversion into corporate events or awards, the signal could prove procedural rather than commercial [P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next update cycle, pre-award solicitations and the regulatory pipeline remain positive while 8-K material events improve from negative and 60-day relative strength stops deteriorating [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The thesis is invalidated if regulatory and pre-award activity retreat, fused acceleration turns non-positive, or price continues to underperform without improvement in material 8-K events [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed despite strong fused acceleration of 1.325 across seven sources [P3]. Congressional net buying is elevated and the regulatory pipeline is positive, but lobbying, federal grant opportunities, material 8-K events, and especially news flow are weakening [P3][P5]. Activity is modestly ahead of price, while the covered group has underperformed the market over 60 days, so price has not confirmed the emerging narrative [P1][P2][P4][P6]. The theme is forming rather than established, supporting MONITOR until gains broaden beyond congressional buying and regulation [P1][P3].
assessments.rationale_zh: 尽管七类来源的综合加速度达到1.325，但真实活动信号仍然好坏参半[P3]。国会议员净买入较强、监管进程偏正面，但游说、联邦资助机会、重大8-K事件，尤其是新闻热度都在走弱[P3][P5]。活动略领先于价格，而相关公司过去60天跑输大盘，说明价格尚未确认这一正在形成的叙事[P1][P2][P4][P6]。目前更适合观察，等待增长扩展至国会买入和监管以外的来源[P1][P3]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Congressional buying and regulatory activity are picking up, but lobbying, federal funding opportunities, corporate event filings, and especially news coverage are slowing. The companies tied to the theme have underperformed the market over the past 60 days, so prices have not yet validated the improvement in real-world activity. Keep watching rather than committing now, and wait for the pickup to spread across more sources.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国会议员买入和监管活动正在增强，但游说、联邦资助机会、公司重大事项披露，尤其是新闻关注度都在放缓。相关公司过去60天跑输大盘，价格尚未验证现实活动的改善。现在宜继续观察，等待更多活动来源同步回升后再考虑参与。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish countercase is that fused acceleration is already high across seven tracked sources and activity leads price, so weak relative performance may represent an early entry window rather than failed confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if subsequent readings show continued positive fused acceleration, improvement in currently negative lobbying, grant, filing, and news signals, and a reversal of 60-day relative underperformance [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if fused acceleration rolls over, congressional or regulatory signals weaken, and relative performance remains negative or deteriorates further [P3][P4].

assessments.name: AI Semiconductors

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately positive but uneven: lobbying (z=0.674), federal grant FOAs (z=0.735), and Congress net buying (z=0.275) are improving, while 8-K material events are weak (z=-1.158), solicitations are nearly flat, and contracts show no signal [P3]. Fused acceleration is strong at 1.266 across seven sources, but the theme is only forming and collapsing news flow (z=-2.61; velocity 0.6, acceleration -0.8) limits evidence that the pickup will persist [P1][P3][P5]. Activity leads price by 0.642z while 60-day relative strength trails the market by 6.49%, creating potentially favorable but still-unconfirmed continuity [P2][P4]. MONITOR is appropriate until improving institutional and federal activity becomes more consistent or price begins to confirm it.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号温和偏强但分化明显：游说、联邦资助机会和国会议员净买入有所改善，而重大公司事件明显偏弱，招标前活动接近持平，政府合同也没有提供支持 [P3]。七个来源的综合加速度较强，但主题仍处于形成阶段，新闻流显著萎缩且继续减速，因此持续性尚未得到充分验证 [P1][P3][P5]。活动领先价格，而过去60天的相对表现落后大盘6.49%，说明存在潜在机会，但价格尚未确认 [P2][P4]。因此目前更适合观察，等待机构与联邦活动进一步趋于一致，或价格开始跟随。
assessments.rationale_plain: Lobbying, federal funding opportunities, and congressional buying are picking up, but corporate disclosures, early procurement activity, and government contracts do not yet tell the same story. Prices have lagged the market by about 6.5% over the past 60 days even as underlying activity improves, so the opportunity may be early rather than broken. Keep watching for broader follow-through in actual spending and corporate activity, or for prices to begin responding, before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 游说活动、联邦资助机会和国会议员买入正在增加，但公司披露、早期采购活动和政府合同尚未呈现同样的趋势。过去60天相关公司股价落后大盘约6.5%，与此同时部分实际活动正在改善，因此机会可能仍处于早期。现阶段宜继续观察，等待实际支出和企业活动出现更一致的增长，或股价开始跟随后再行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bearish case is that the apparent acceleration is being carried by lobbying and grant opportunities rather than realized contracts or company events: contracts are neutral, solicitations slightly negative, 8-K events sharply negative, and news flow is exceptionally weak [P3][P5]. Price underperformance may therefore reflect correctly fading commercial momentum rather than a delayed reaction [P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the narrative if the next observation shows contracts, pre-award solicitations, or 8-K material events turning clearly positive while lobbying and grant activity remain positive, accompanied by improving relative price strength [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if lobbying or grant signals roll over, fused acceleration falls toward or below zero, and relative price strength remains negative without improvement in contracts, solicitations, or material company events [P3][P4].

assessments.name: AI Software & Platforms

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across three of four sources: government contracts (-2.129), congressional net buying (-1.255), and lobbying (-0.979); only 8-K material events are marginally positive (0.175) [P3]. The theme is fading and activity trails price sharply (-2.909), while 60-day relative price strength remains strong, indicating that market performance has run ahead of underlying activity [P1][P2][P4]. The modest positive fused acceleration (0.391) offers an early counter-signal, but it lacks support from the individual sources and there is no news leg [P3][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 四类信号中有三类明显偏弱：政府合同、国会议员净买入和游说活动均在下降，只有重大公司事件略有改善 [P3]。该主题正处于消退阶段，现实活动显著落后于价格，而过去60天的相对价格表现仍然强劲，说明市场走势已经跑在基本活动之前 [P1][P2][P4]。综合活动的轻微回升提供了一点反向信号，但尚未得到各分项支持，也没有新闻推动 [P3][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, congressional buying and lobbying activity tied to large drugmakers are all slowing, while reported material corporate events have improved only slightly. Their shares have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so prices appear to be running ahead of the underlying activity. The small hint of stabilization is not yet supported widely enough; avoid chasing the move unless several activity measures turn higher.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与大型制药企业相关的政府合同、国会议员买入和游说活动都在放缓，重大公司事件仅略有改善。与此同时，这些公司的股价在过去60天跑赢大盘，说明价格走势已经领先于现实活动。目前只有轻微的企稳迹象，支持仍不够广泛，因此不宜追高，除非多项活动指标同步回升。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that fused acceleration has already turned positive across four monitored sources, potentially marking an early trough before the individual measures recover [P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Maintain the AVOID view if the next readings keep government contracts, congressional net buying, and lobbying below neutral while relative price strength remains positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reverse toward MONITOR or ENTER if at least two of those three weak activity sources turn positive and fused acceleration strengthens while price has not advanced further [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Big Pharma

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all three measured sources: congressional net buying is below trend, lobbying is sharply depressed, and material 8-K events are also below trend [P3]. The theme is fading, with activity substantially lagging price, while miners have still outperformed the market over 60 days [P1][P2][P4]. With no supporting news leg, the price move appears poorly grounded and unlikely to persist without a renewed activity impulse [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 三项现实活动指标均偏弱：国会议员净买入低于常态，游说活动大幅低迷，重大8-K事件也低于常态 [P3]。该主题正在衰退，现实活动明显落后于价格，但相关矿企过去60天仍跑赢大盘 [P1][P2][P4]。同时缺乏新闻催化，当前涨势的现实支撑不足，若没有新的活动回升，延续性较差 [P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying and corporate event activity are all subdued, with lobbying particularly weak. Yet silver miners have outperformed the market over the past 60 days, and there is no supporting wave of news. The price move therefore appears ahead of the underlying activity, so investors should stay away until real-world signals improve.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关买入、游说活动和企业重大事项均较低迷，其中游说活动尤其疲弱。然而，白银矿企过去60天仍跑赢大盘，同时也没有明显的新闻推动。这表明价格上涨领先于现实活动，投资者宜暂时回避，等待实际信号改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest countercase is that the combined activity measure is still positive across three sources, while 60-day relative performance is also positive; this could represent an early stabilization that the fading classification has not yet captured [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the avoidance case if the next update still shows all three source readings below trend, activity continuing to lag price, and no news support [P2][P3][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if lobbying, congressional buying and material-event activity turn broadly positive while activity moves ahead of price and relative performance remains firm [P2][P3][P4].

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward emerging AI compute, semiconductor equipment, and space where activity leads price, with confirmed strength in staples, cybersecurity, and gold miners; health care, energy, fintech, and prior speculative leaders are fading or confirmed down.
